fusions.name: Tap It Level
fusions.desc: Brings the trowel's heel down, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Bedded Flat
fusions.desc: A flattening blow that deals 32 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Settled Swing
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 12 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Struck True
fusions.desc: Your blunt damage ignores 12% of armour.
